title: The Price of Not Planning: Parallel Sampling Depth Peaks at the Reconstruction Threshold
abstract: arXiv:2611.21285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion models sample the tokens of one round independently. Planned decoders first generate a coarse plan, then fill in the tokens in parallel. We ask when a plan saves rounds, how many it saves, and how fine it must be. We study this on broadcast trees: the leaves are the tokens, the internal nodes are the plan, and the edge correlation $\theta$ sets how strongly tokens depend on the plan. Errors are measured by the forward Kullback-Leibler divergence $\varepsilon$, and the lower bounds hold for every deterministic value-adaptive rule, also with learned conditionals. We show that a decoder without the plan needs of order $\min\{n,(n/\varepsilon)^{\alpha}\}$ rounds below the reconstruction threshold, where $\alpha=\log b/(4\log(1/\theta))$ rises to $1/2$ at the threshold, and that the exponent stays below $1/2$ above it (binary channel: $0.02\le\theta\le0.98$). With the plan, $\log_b n+1$ rounds suffice. In the binary model bel

translated_title: 不规划的代价：并行采样深度在重构阈值处达到峰值
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型在每一轮中独立地采样各个 token。规划式解码器先生成一个粗略计划，然后再并行填充 token。我们探讨：计划何时能节省轮数、能节省多少轮，以及计划需要多精细。我们在广播树上研究这一问题：叶子节点对应 token，内部节点对应计划，边相关性 $\theta$ 决定 token 对计划的依赖强度。误差以前向 Kullback-Leibler 散度 $\varepsilon$ 度量，且这些下界对每一个确定性的价值自适应规则都成立，即便使用学习到的条件分布也是如此。我们证明：没有计划的解码器在重构阈值以下需要 $\min\{n,(n/\varepsilon)^{\alpha}\}$ 量级的轮数，其中 $\alpha=\log b/(4\log(1/\theta))$ 在阈值处升至 $1/2$，而在阈值之上该指数保持在 $1/2$ 以下（二值信道：$0.02\le\theta\le0.98$）。有了计划，$\log_b n+1$ 轮即可足够。在二值模型中……（原文摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 本文在广播树模型上证明：无规划的并行采样所需轮数的指数恰好在重构阈值处达到峰值 $1/2$，而采用“先规划、后并行填充”的解码器仅需 $\log_b n+1$ 轮，从而定量刻画了“不规划”的代价。
en_tdlr: This paper proves on broadcast trees that the exponent of plan-free parallel sampling depth peaks at 1/2 exactly at the reconstruction threshold, while a plan-then-fill decoder needs only log_b n + 1 rounds, thereby quantifying the price of not planning.
